title: Ray Fowler's Sylvania contractors report UFOs to Condon investigator

tellings.quote: Uh Ray Fowler was um a manager working with under Sylvania Corporation.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, tells a story about a man named Ray Fowler, a manager at Sylvania, a company doing contract work for the military. According to Salas, in 1967 Fowler's contract workers at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana reported UFOs to Roy Craig, an investigator for the Condon study, a university study of UFOs paid for by the Air Force in the late 1960s. If true, it would mean civilian workers backed up reports of UFOs at a military base and passed them to the official investigators.
